timing: AFTER reading first three published-source movement effect results; exploratory analysis, NOT independent confirmation
scientific_question: At actual matched-daylength GPS observation dates, does the region-level direction of thermal and hydroclimate season shift coincide with night/day displacement reallocation? This cannot identify causation because taxon and site are confounded.
locked_source_cohort: Exactly three original Movebank source archive/bitstream MD5s already frozen in MOVEBANK_NATIVE_OBSERVATION_PILOT_20261019.json; do not replace based on ecological signs
preserve_existing_result: Replicate existing unmodified MOVEBANK_SOLAR_MOVEMENT_V0_20261019.json estimator and compare exact source-level means with results below BEFORE assessing climate
weather: Open-Meteo historical archive, explicitly ERA5, native elevation (elevation=nan), nearest grid, UTC-offset-based fixed mean local standard dates (round(longitude/15) hours). Daily mean temperature °C and preceding-30-day sum(precipitation-ET0) mm. Original response hashes recorded; not individual microclimate, actual soil moisture or forage.
calendar: Only dates that passed existing prespecified GPS step and same-photoperiod date pairing rules; no date threshold changes. Retain provider missingness.
aggregation: Individual-year paired effects and paired environment difference averaged within years, then equal years per individual, equal individuals within source. Within-animal slopes are exploratory and reflect serial day/date dependence; no p-values or across-species trait-law inference.
outputs: Three source-level regional environment+animal contrasts, source retries and response hashes; no raw coordinates, tagged animal IDs or matched dates emitted.
caveats: All climate locations are coarse publicly named study-region reference points, not recovered individual GPS positions. Diet/movement species differences confounded with region and year. A future repeated population across hydroclimatic contexts is needed for explanation.
